audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 with 50.54% over 1391 games fits a lane where his all-in is telegraphed by the wall vault but kills outright if Across the Veil is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes is the generic "full kit at 3 / level 6 adds the zone / Luden's" template with nothing about Talon.
audit.why: His level 6 is Shadow Assault at 100/80/60s — stealth, move speed and converging blades, with no execute — so the spike line should say what changes against him.

The decisive interactions are stated: Assassin's Path is near-zero cooldown but puts the used wall on a long one, so his engage and his escape are the same wall; Noxian Diplomacy leaps only from 575 against your 900 Q; Blade's End bleeds when the third Wound stack meets an auto. All three appear in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and early.

audit.why: Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s — 15 seconds is not a cooldown in his kit and the number is simply wrong.
